Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
options: shall be
will be
can be
would be
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is "will be"

Explanation:
☛ The correct answer is "will be" because it expresses a definite future action.
☛ In the sentence "Teachers will be given continuous opportunities...", the passive voice is used, where "will be" indicates a planned or certain future event.
☛ "Shall be" is typically used for commands or promises, while "can be" and "would be" imply uncertainty or conditions, which are inappropriate here.
☛ The context describes a planned initiative (providing opportunities), making the simple future tense (will be) the most grammatically accurate choice.

☛ The phrase 'including protection from cardiovascular disease and cancer' indicates that the benefits are many, making Numerous (many in number) the most appropriate choice.
☛ Countable (can be counted) and Limited (restricted) are incorrect as they restrict the scope, while Few (a small number) doesn't fit the positive context.
☛ Grammar Rule: The adjective is used with a plural noun ('benefits') to emphasize quantity.

Today, overweight children are becoming a common (5) _________ in many countries.

 

Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
options_hi: to
in
at
on
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है "to"

Explanation:
☛ यहाँ "prone" शब्द के बाद "to" preposition का उपयोग किया जाता है क्योंकि "prone to" एक fixed phrase है जो किसी चीज़ के प्रति संवेदनशीलता या जोखिम को दर्शाता है।
☛ Example: "She is prone to allergies."
☛ अन्य prepositions जैसे "in", "at", या "on" इस context में grammatically incorrect हैं क्योंकि वे "prone" के साथ नहीं लगते।
☛ यह grammar rule competitive exams में अक्सर पूछा जाता है, इसलिए students को "prone to + noun/health issue" structure याद रखना चाहिए।
